after:
# Sharded three ways as well (APRV-159), and it compiles once as the shards
    # do. The floor still proves everything before main: run-tests.mjs assigns
    # each discovered file to exactly one shard, so the three legs together are
    # the whole suite and only the wall clock changed. Unsharded, the floor was
    # the merge-queue candidate's long pole at 11 to 14.5 minutes, one
    # `node --test` pool on two runner cores still grinding after the Node 22
    # shards had finished. The aggregator below needs no change for this:
    # GitHub reports one result for a matrix job and it is `success` only when
    # every shard succeeded, so `needs['full-floor'].result` answers the
    # FLOOR_REQUIRED question exactly as it did when the leg was a single job.
    # No lint step: oxlint's verdict does not vary by Node major, and every
    # shard above already has it.
    name: full gate (node 20 floor, shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
    needs: classify
    if: >-
      needs.classify.outputs.tier == 'full' &&
      (github.event_name == 'merge_group' ||
      (github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - run: node scripts/run-tests.mjs --shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3
before:
# Unsharded, and it compiles once as the shards do. One version running
    # once needs no matrix to coordinate, and the aggregator below reads its
    # single result. No lint step: oxlint's verdict does not vary by Node
    # major, and every shard above already has it.
    name: full gate (node 20 floor)
    needs: classify
    if: >-
      needs.classify.outputs.tier == 'full' &&
      (github.event_name == 'merge_group' ||
      (github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - run: node scripts/run-tests.mjs
